job.title: Offer Block Extraction from Flyer PDFs
job.description:
Develop a solution that extracts offer blocks from flyer PDFs and captures the following details:
• Coordinates of each offer block (X, Y, Width, Height)
• Text content, including Offer Name, Offer Price, Offer Type, Packaging Size, and other relevant information.
job.objective: Develop a solution that extracts offer blocks from flyer PDFs and captures key details.

process: Detect and segment individual offer blocks
Use OCR to extract and classify the text
scope.output: CSV format with one row per offer block

proposal.text:
Hi there,

Your project instantly caught my attention — extracting structured offer data from flyer PDFs is a challenge I’m well-prepared for. I've worked on similar projects involving OCR and PDF parsing, including a Patent Similarity Analyzer that scanned complex PDF layouts, extracted fields, and mapped them into structured formats.

With hands-on experience in:

OCR using Tesseract and layout-aware tools like LayoutParser

Parsing multi-page PDFs and isolating data-rich segments

Delivering clean, organized outputs (CSV/Excel) from semi-structured documents

I can develop a streamlined tool that detects offer blocks, captures coordinates, and classifies each offer’s text into usable fields — all aligned with your specifications.

Would you be open to a quick call or message exchange to confirm the type of flyers you're working with and whether there’s a consistent layout across them?

Looking forward to helping you turn those PDFs into actionable data.

Patent Similarity Analyzer: https://github.com/Adieltheanalyst/patent-similarity-analyzer
OCR: https://github.com/Adieltheanalyst/OCR-Optical-Character-Recognition-

Best regards,
Adiel Ngugi
